description:
Trusted Connectivity for AI-Powered Dominance. 

 Everfox delivers trusted connectivity to protect the world’s most critical environments and safeguard the sensitive data powering decision advantage. 

 Built for mission-critical operations, Everfox protects what matters most by securing how data moves, how users access it, and how threats are neutralized across every domain. We enable mission speed and secure collaboration across networks, domains, and allies, while ensuring the data powering AI and advanced analytics remains trusted and protected. 

 We don’t just defend systems; we deliver decision dominance. 

 Our Purpose. Protect what matters most by enabling organizations to operate security in the most complex and high-risk digital environments. 
 Our Vision . To be the most trusted authority in high-assurance cybersecurity, enabling secure collaboration across every domain. 
 Our Belief. Security should never limit mission success – it should enable it. 
 
 Our Promise. We deliver absolute confidence in environments where failure is not an option. 

 



 We’re hiring for a hybrid role. You’ll work on-site with your team several days each week (typically 2–3), with the specific days set by your manager. Because regular in-person collaboration is central to this job, we look for candidates who live within about 50 miles of the office.

 Everfox will consider reasonable accommodation as required by law.


 About the role: 
 We’re looking for a full-time Kubernetes and Linux Container Platform Engineer to join our team developing and maintaining the container infrastructure that supports EverShieldour Insider Risk platform. In this role, you will contribute to the accelerated development of our Evershield Platform while supporting the ongoing maintenance of our container platform, helping the team meet current and future product delivery commitments.
 The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Kubernetes, container technologies, and Red Hat Enterprise Linux, along with expertise in building, deploying, and maintaining scalable, reliable platform solutions. Working in an Agile environment, you will collaborate with team members to design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain container infrastructure to support EverShield’s evolving needs.

 Location:   Hybrid – Salt Lake City, Utah 

 Key Responsibilities  
 Working collaboratively with team members to design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and deliver a scalable Linux-based container platform 
 Remaining up to date on current best practices, trends, and industry developments and actively sharing that knowledge with other team members  
 Verifying product features are thoroughly implemented, ensuring all requirements are met, using robust technical solutions and high-quality coding standards  
 
  Key Experience and Education qualifications: 
 BS Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security or equivalent work experience 
 Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, communication and customer service skills 
 Strong time management skills and able to take initiative and work independently on concurrent projects 
 4+ years of professional experience using container technologies to build, deploy, maintain, or administer containers in a production environment 
 3+ years of professional experience building, maintain, or administering Kubernetes clusters in a production environment 
 5+ years of professional experience administering and/or developing applications on Red Hat Enterprise Linux. This includes; 
 Demonstrable coding/scripting experience in Bash. 
 A solid understanding and experience using the Linux command line and its associated tools and utilities. 
 A solid understanding of fundamental networking concepts. 
 Experience with server virtualization systems such as VMware ESXi/vSphere.  
 Experience with Ansible and familiarity with YAML and JSON. 
 Experience deploying applications to AWS and/or Azure in a production environment (compute, storage, networking, image creation, etc.) 
 If needed, ability to pass a government background check 
 
 Nice to Have  
 Experience with installation, administration, and configuration of Prometheus and Grafana. 
 Knowledgeable in Linux and application security best practices, SELinux, DISA STIG, etc. 
 Experience with UI frameworks and technologies (HTML, JavaScript, REST APIs, React) 
 Experience with CI/CD and configuration management tools (Jenkins, Ansible, Artifactory)   
 Experience writing automated tests 
 Experience using Git for version control  
 Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment 
 Experience with Python and Golang 
 


 
 A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:
$125,100.00-164,000.00 USD
 The actual salary offered may vary within the range based on a candidates' unique experience, locale, and business needs. In addition to a base salary and bonus plans, Everfox offers a generous benefits package including flexible PTO, a 401k match, and contribution to healthcare coverages. Our Talent Acquisition team will provide specific information regarding bonus eligibility and benefits offerings.

 ________________________________________________________________

 Don’t meet every single qualification? Studies show people are hesitant to apply if they don’t meet all requirements listed in a job posting. If there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team. 

 Everfox is an equal employment opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws prohibiting discrimination. Everfox does not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital status, medical condition, or any other category protected by applicable law. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to humanresources@everfox.com . 

 Everfox is a Federal Contractor. Certain positions with Everfox require access to controlled goods and technologies subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations or the Export Administration Regulations. Applicants for these positions may need to be "U.S. Persons," as defined in these regulations. Generally, a "U.S. Person" is a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or an individual who has been admitted as a refugee or granted asylum. 

 Applicants must have the right to work in the location to which you have applied.
